decisions.statement: A seat is idle only where nothing is in flight and no child is busy and Claude is present.
A count that was not read is not a count of zero.
A seat with a count that was not read is not idle.
A restart that keeps the session running ignores the children the seat dispatched.
Past the context cliff only work in flight has a restart back.
A busy reason names each count that is not zero and says `unread` for a count never read.
A child of the seat running MCP is no busy child.
An MCP child is known by a marker in its command line rather than by its name.
Nothing here reads a process or a port or a page.

definition: whether the agent in a seat is doing nothing at this moment
